same_source_profile_theorem.adopted_premise: the central flavor holonomy is preserved by the same neutral mass action; no separate Majorana-breaking source is added
same_source_profile_theorem.statement: At the one-holonomy profile tier, the same central connection that supplies phi must be respected by every neutral mass block. For phi not equal to 0 or pi/3 modulo 2pi/3, no Majorana bilinear is invariant, while the selected L-Nc Dirac channel remains lawful. Thus the executed nonselfconjugate profile is Dirac-only without a new ontology parameter.
